title: Automation Without Understanding
summary: Two developments are unfolding at once: artificial intelligence systems have begun to produce genuine research-level mathematics, and the United States is weakening the pipeline that produces humans capable of understanding what such systems are doing. This essay argues that, taken together, these developments amount to a strategic error.
